evidence: The route connects the West Matukituki Valley with the Dart Valley.
DOC recommends trampers begin from the Matukituki side as ascending is much safer than descending.
Slightly upstream from the confluence of the Dart and Snowy Creek, a bridge over the creek leads to Dart Hut.

access_points.name: Rees-Dart Track
access_points.quote: the route can be accessed via the Rees-Dart Track

exits.name: Rees-Dart Track
exits.quote: Walk out via the Rees or Dart Valleys on the Rees-Dart Track.

doubts: No features given; the Raspberry Creek car park has no ref. DOC's 4-5 days appears to include the 2 day walk out from Dart Hut, but the page names no exact road end, so the way is ended at Dart Hut and the walk out is recorded as an exit on the Rees-Dart Track. The two 'stream' crossings near the bushline and the side streams are unnamed fords. The page notes the route is more dangerous in reverse; walking it the other way is not another way.
